mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand contraction that intensifies recession fears, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) during early recession phases signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate profitability, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines during early recession, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annually signals inflationary pressures that prompt monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as bond yields rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 50,000 in a single month signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines > 50,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad demand weakness that accelerates recession risks, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-interest-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals excessive monetary tightening that risks recession, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.
